---
title: "🗓️ Week 02 - Geospatial data and geographical information"
---

In this week, we will cover the following topics:

**Theoretical topics**:

What are the most important characteristics of geographic data?

How are geographic data transformed into information?

What conceptual models are used to represent geographic objects and phenomena

What are the most commonly used data structures and formats?


## 👨‍🏫 Lecture Slides 

You can find the slides [here](slides.qmd)

## **Practical exercises**

1. Follow [these instructions](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Rg52rbJTiantbiTvrh2apyuS6UPpaj4R/view?usp=sharing) to extract *municipios* and *elevation* for your department and change their symbology. 

2. Follow these steps to add *cities* to your department:

  - Download  a zip file with [world cities](https://simplemaps.com/data/world-cities)

  - Add the unzipped csv file as ["Delimited Text Layer"](https://guides.library.duke.edu/QGIS/ImportData)

  - Select the cities corresponding to your study area
  
  - Export the selected cities as a geopackage

  - Change Symbology for the cities in your department
